name: FTC proposed Policy Statement Concerning the Suppression of Accuracy in AI Systems
summary: Proposed FTC policy statement, issued for public comment, stating that distorting AI outputs toward undisclosed ideological objectives could be a deceptive practice under Section 5 of the FTC Act, and that state laws requiring such deception may be impliedly preempted. It names Colorado's AI Act as an example. It responds to a directive in EO 14365. The comment period closed 31 July 2026; no final policy statement was located as of 5 October 2026.
key_obligations: Proposed position that deceptive output distortion violates Section 5, including when done to comply with state law
Statement of agency enforcement approach, not a binding rule

timeline.note: FTC announced the proposed policy statement and opened public comment (docket FTC-2026-0859, as written in the press release text); Commission authorized the notice 2-0.
Public comment period closed; no final policy statement located as of 2026-10-05.
